messages:
noah: quick brain-dump: we should prototype a 'micro-lease fastpath' at the edge to service tiny token requests locally for a short time, without hitting global allocator for every chat turn. cuts RTT for p95/p99.

priya: +1 for latency, but how do we avoid local leases enabling noisy tenants to skirt global fairness?

noah: design sketch: each edge keeps tiny per-tenant leases (micro-leases). properties: very small cap (e.g. 100 tokens), short TTL (20s), and lease_decay which reduces available tokens if churn detected. leases are best-effort and reconciled async.

yves: what's lease_decay?

noah: decay is multiplicative backoff on remaining tokens when abuse/churn score crosses threshold. decay_factor=0.5 -> remaining tokens halved each punitive tick. keeps fastpath useful for gentle bursts but shrinks for aggressive patterns.

lina: how to detect churn robustly without false positives? too aggressive decay could hurt real users.

noah: churn heuristic: high allocate-to-global-alloc-ratio + short inter-request intervals + spike in token consumption variance over 1m window. need tunable thresholds; start conservative for canary.

priya: refill strategy? can't flood global allocator with simultaneous top-ups.

noah: refill is stochastic with cooperative drain: edges try topup with low probability p(t) inversely proportional to recent topups and include random jitter. also include a leader-bid when we see multi-edge traffic for same tenant: simple deterministic bid = hash(edge_id || epoch) mod N; winner does the topup for that tenant for the window.

yves: leader logic can be tricky across rollbacks. maybe keep leader optional: default to probabilistic topups, enable leader mode when >M concurrent edges report same tenant.

lina: accounting correctness: how do we ensure total consumed tokens reconcile with global state?

noah: every local consume emits a compact 'consumed event' to the accounting stream (batched). global allocator treats micro-leases as short-lived provisional allocations and reconciles by subtracting consumed events from outstanding leases. we accept short windows of eventual consistency but bound maximum drift via small lease caps and TTLs.

priya: failure modes: edge crash losing unreported consumption -> global over-issuance. mitigation?

yves: require grace eviction: leases are auto-expiring; edges periodically checkpoint outstanding lease usage to a durable store / audit broker. if checkpoint not seen, reconciler flags potential overissue and triggers conservative global throttles for that tenant.

noah: operational metrics: per-tenant per-edge: micro_lease_tokens, micro_lease_consumed, micro_lease_topups, micro_lease_evictions, micro_lease_ttl_expirations. global: micro_topup_rejections, outstanding_lease_drift. alerts: sustained outstanding_lease_drift > X tokens or micro_topup_rejections > 0.5% -> rollback.

lina: rollout plan?

noah: propose 3-stage canary:
- stage A: internal-only tenants in a single low-traffic AZ, feature-flag off globally. monitor drift and topups.
- stage B: selected low-volume external tenants in one region for 48h with gradual increase of micro_lease_cap (50 -> 100 -> 200).
- stage C: region-wide but keep global cap low and ops kill-switch ready.

priya: rollback conditions? define hard thresholds.

noah: rollback if any of: allocator_qps increases > 8% sustained over 10m, outstanding_lease_drift > 500 tokens for 5m for any tenant, or topup_rejections spike > 1% absolute. ops-bot can auto-flip feature-flag.

yves: can we simulate worst-case noisy tenant to ensure abuse isn't trivial?

oah: yes I'll include a small sim with a noisy tenant pattern: many tiny requests from many edges, with churn score and lease decay enabled. will publish convergence graphs in RFC.

lina: tests for partitioning: edges should enter conservative mode (no topups) when they lose contact with allocator for >2 RTTs and gracefully drain leases. need explicit test vectors in the RFC.

ops-bot: NOTE: ticket created: PLAT-9987 micro-lease fastpath canary. automatic alerting for topup_rejections and outstanding_lease_drift enabled. :robot_face:

priya: next: please draft RFC with config knobs (max_lease_tokens, lease_ttl_seconds, decay_factor, churn_thresholds, topup_probability, leader_mode_threshold). include canary runbook and SRE checklist. I'll own the checklist and alarming.

noah: will do. estimated prototype timeline: 1 week for sim + edge stubs, 2 weeks to instrument and run canary. thanks all.
